description: Shake-table Tests of Seven-story Reinforced Concrete Structures with Torsional Irregularities is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Shyh-Jiann Hwang, National Taiwan University (ntu.edu.tw). This experimental project was made possible by an international collaboration between the National Centre for Research on Earthquake Engineering (NCREE), Taiwan and QuakeCoRE, New Zealand Centre for Earthquake Resilience. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Shake table test; Inelastic Torsion; Irregularities; Existing buildings; Reinforced Concrete. Published 2021-04-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
